At the first root α*, F_p(0,a1)=iJ_{1−α*}(α*) and F_v(0,a1)=−(3α*²/4)G’(α*). J denominator cannot vanish there: then adjacent-order Bessel recurrence would give a solution and derivative both zero, contradicting Bessel ODE uniqueness. IFT gives p1(v)=i c1(v−a1)+O((v−a1)²), c1=−(3α*²/4)G’/J; cosine expansion of E=2−(4g/3)cos p gives E_min−E1=(2/3)c1²g(v−a1)²+O(g|v−a1|³). Independent high-precision mpmath evaluation reproduced α*=0.906338059174892129878, c1≈8.696131059428713262743 and K≈50.41513026850716994685, but decimals are not rigorously interval enclosed. No nonperturbative full-chain assertion.
